Government of the People's Republic of B: The Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh issues official notifications through its ministries.
Ministry of Finance: The Ministry of Finance acts as the parent authority for the Internal Resources Division regarding customs and tax matters.
Internal Resources Division: The Internal Resources Division is the specific department within the Ministry of Finance responsible for overseeing customs and value added tax policy.

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of this Act provides the government with the legal authority to amend customs notifications in the public interest.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of this Act is cited as a supporting legal provision for the amendment of the customs notification.
National Board of Revenue: The government is required to consult with this board before issuing or amending official customs notifications.
S.R.O. 150-AIN/2013: This existing notification is amended to insert new headings and entries into its associated table.
H.S. Code: New commodity codes and their corresponding descriptions are added to the table of the existing notification to update the list of dutiable or exempted items.
Specifically, entries for air vent heads, doors, windows, signaling equipment, and electric panels are inserted into the relevant classification schedule.
